title: atlifm - terminal-style file manager for Linux
description: atlifm is a mouse-first, terminal-style file manager for Linux with Miller columns, tabs, previews, interactive archives, drag and drop, plugins and an XDG desktop portal.

docs.title: Welcome to atlifm
docs.description: Introduction to atlifm: a terminal-style file manager for Linux with Miller columns, tabs, previews, archives, drag and drop and an XDG desktop portal.

docs.title: Downloads
docs.description: Install atlifm on Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, RHEL, Arch, Alpine or as an AppImage. Packages from COPR, the Ubuntu PPA and the openSUSE Build Service.

docs.title: User Guide
docs.description: Learn how to use atlifm: navigation, tabs, previews, archives, drag and drop, bookmarks, undo, keybindings and the XDG file chooser portal.

docs.title: Plugin Developer Guide
docs.description: Build atlifm plugins: configuration actions, shell scripts and native C++ plugins through a stable C ABI.

docs.title: Configuration Reference
docs.description: Complete atlifm configuration reference: config files, keybindings, themes, plugins and desktop portal settings.
